description: Implementation of the Recommendations of the Committee appointed to review the Recruitment Process and Cadre Management in the Public Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-12-30 to appoint an Officials’ Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to review the recruitment process in the Public Service, identify the needs, priorities and time frames and take necessary action regarding the number of recruitments to be made in this regard. Taking into account the requests submitted to the said Committee by the respective Ministries to fill the vacancies existing in the departments and other institutions under their purview, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to grant approval to the respective Ministries and institutions to make the following recruitments as per the recommendations made by the said Committee at its meeting held on 2025-10-02, was approved by the Cabinet:
